step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture illustrates Spine.ai's computer vision cataloging pipeline. 1) Input images (IMAGE) arrive via API Gateway, which routes requests down to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). 2) The ALB distributes traffic to ECS cluster tasks that parse image metadata/parameters. 3) ECS pushes jobs into appropriate SQS queues. 4) The SQS queues feed into the EC2-based Processing layer (divided into PRE, INFER, POST compute workloads). 5) In parallel, the Training Pipeline (TP) uses SageMaker, fetching input training data from S3 and saving trained weights back to S3. 6) Upon benchmark completion, SageMaker triggers Lambda, which synchronizes updated model weights into the Processing layer.
